title: Cross-mouse conditional choice probability
current_best_explanation: No current global winner has been verified on this exact frozen input, split and scorer. A published dataset name or broad leaderboard lead is insufficient.
executed_endpoint: IBL December 2019 archive, 83 training/17 test mice across the same nine labs; 13 columns: current contrasts, experimenter block prior and five past choices/feedbacks. Nonoverlapping six-trial blocks ensure scored targets never reappear as histories. Mouse-equal binary log loss. No complete test-session sequence or target feedback supplied.

existing_reference.name: Paper-inspired pooled behavioral GLM with stimulus basis, lag1 rewarded/unrewarded choice terms and block prior
existing_reference.evidence: A: same canonical numerical input and mouse-equal training weights.
existing_reference.strength: Genuine IBL task basis and interpretable conditional choice model.
problems: Pooled transfer adaptation, not the original per-animal model fits.
Only lag1 used despite five allowed history lags.
Known experimenter prior is privileged information not directly cued to the animal.
existing_reference.verification_scope: Only the named locally audited reference/archived outputs, not every newer candidate or equal-budget/global optimality.

candidates.name: Regularized multi-lag task-specific behavioral GLM
candidates.evidence: C: matched extension of source model family.
candidates.information_match: Use all five allowed history lags/interactions; select regularization on training mice only.

candidates.name: IBL ActionKernel / StimulusKernel / OptimalBayesian models
candidates.evidence: B: official current task-specific model implementations.
candidates.information_match: Native session inference and accumulated histories exceed the frozen five-lag independent-block input; fit population parameters on allowed training histories only, without test fitting.

candidates.name: PsyTrack / GLM-HMM strategy model
candidates.evidence: B: established relevant IBL behavioral specialists.
candidates.information_match: Latent temporal fitting requires continuous sessions and potentially test responses; not drop-in under independent frozen rows.

candidates.name: Hybrid neural–cognitive reward-learning models
candidates.evidence: B/C: recent primary human learning work, not mouse-transfer benchmark evidence.
candidates.information_match: Different task/species and sequential information; domain relevance alone does not establish fit or a win.

recommended_next_comparator: Training-mouse-selected regularized behavioral GLM with all permitted lags and reward interactions; separate full-session track for official action-kernel/GLM-HMM/PsyTrack inference.
switching_assessment: ADD stronger same-information history modeling, Tier C; retain source-inspired GLM. Do not advertise a current best cognitive model from a conditional forecast with privileged prior, or use test-history reconstruction to fit a session model.
limitations: Historical beta-quality source release, not all modern IBL QC.
Labs overlap; unseen-mouse is not unseen-lab transfer.
Do not join test rows or reconstruct scored choices from histories.
Per-mouse dynamic model fitting with hidden test choices violates the contract.
Prediction accuracy cannot establish recovery of the animal learning mechanism.

evidence_tiers.A: Locally executed and audited on this frozen protocol; establishes a comparator result, not universal optimality.
evidence_tiers.B: Primary method/benchmark with relevant task evidence but an unmatched split, inputs, scorer or budget.
evidence_tiers.C: Author repository, preprint, mathematical proposal or adaptation requiring additional validation.
evidence_tiers.D: Unresolved access, unavailable artifacts or input mismatch precludes an executable recommendation.

execution_policy: Literature review only. No inference, fitting, new scores, checkpoint downloads, frozen protocol edits or result changes. Any new comparator requires a prospective amendment, frozen training-only selection and separate result records.
score_import_policy: No unmatched published numbers were imported into benchmark scores.
